LESSON: NAMES OF SCRIPTURES

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 4.1: Names of Scriptures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Names of Scriptures. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise scriptures from the four faiths for awareness of his/her faith
2. appreciate the scriptures as sacred.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise scriptures from the four faiths for awareness of his/her faith
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise scriptures from the four faiths for awareness of his/her faith. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the scriptures as sacred.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the scriptures as sacred. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Names of Scriptures.
2. Explain Names of Scriptures to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Names of Scriptures.
4. Show that you can: recognise scriptures from the four faiths for awareness of his/her faith
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Names of Scriptures. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Names of Scriptures important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recognise scriptures from the four faiths for awareness of his/her faith
2. appreciate the scriptures as sacred.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
